arm: capacity x regularization (w48/w96 x dropout, 400 ep)
instrument: AoA 15-20 proxy + full split + gap.py, one seed each
note: The mechanism is the point. In-sample rho climbs 0.634 -> 0.863 with capacity, so the underfitting IS fixed and nearly all the new fit goes to memorization (seen/unseen gap 1.10x -> 1.75x) -- round 8's reading of its own ladder was right. What is new: held-out rho moves for the first time (0.609 -> 0.620), it moves WITH the regularizer not against it, and the gain sits almost entirely in sps (+0.92), i.e. the error tail. Dropout is monotone through 0.30 and not exhausted. Since the gain looks variance-driven and ensembling already reduces variance, the 1.15 test is the one that decides it -- this is exactly how ozdo died.
